examples.text: Наверное, он сейчас прямо придёт.
examples.trans: He will probably arrive right now.

examples.text: Я вчера пошёл к Елене Павловне.
examples.trans: Yesterday I went to see Elena Pavlovna.

examples.text: Я сделал ей нормальное предложение.
examples.trans: I made her a proper marriage proposal.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'maybe', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Может, лучше обсудим это в постели?
examples.trans: Maybe we should discuss this in bed instead?

examples.text: Мало ли что может случиться.
examples.trans: You never know what might happen.

examples.text: Может быть, они просто сидели рядом?
examples.trans: Maybe they were simply sitting next to each other?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'whether', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я просто уважаю её как личность.
examples.trans: I simply respect her as a person.

examples.text: Мы с Федей хотели выпить пива.
examples.trans: Fedya and I wanted to drink some beer.

examples.text: Ребята, меня дома сильно ударили.
examples.trans: Guys, I got hit hard at home.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'such, what sort', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Зачем так сильно расстраиваться сейчас?
examples.trans: Why get so upset right now?

examples.text: Не мог же я такое рассказать!
examples.trans: I could not possibly tell that story!

examples.text: Никто меня ещё так не любил!
examples.trans: Nobody has ever loved me like this before!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'целовать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to kiss', paired with 'целовать'.

examples.text: А может ли такой человек поцеловать Сашу?
examples.trans: And could such a person kiss Sasha?

examples.text: Это он всем врал и поцеловал Сашу!
examples.trans: He is the one who lied to everyone and kissed Sasha!

examples.text: Поцелуй маму.
examples.trans: Give Mum a kiss.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'after all', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мог, ведь он раньше с ней встречался.
examples.trans: He could, because he used to date her before.

examples.text: Я ведь говорил!
examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'earlier', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мог, ведь он раньше с ней встречался.
examples.trans: He could, because he used to date her before.

examples.text: В моей комнате раньше дядя Миша жил.
examples.trans: Uncle Misha used to live in my room.

examples.text: Раньше здесь был старый парк.
examples.trans: There used to be an old park here.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'with / from', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Шеф сегодня ещё не приходил?
examples.trans: Has the Chef not arrived yet today?

examples.text: Наверное, он сейчас прямо придёт.
examples.trans: He will probably arrive right now.

examples.text: Я сделал ей нормальное предложение.
examples.trans: I made her a proper marriage proposal.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: И она сразу сказала мне да!
examples.trans: And she immediately said yes to me!

examples.text: Зачем ты кидаешь в меня макаронами?
examples.trans: Why are you throwing macaroni at me?

examples.text: Папа, а если бы она тебе отказала?
examples.trans: Dad, and what if she had turned you down?

meanings.en: to date, to go out (with someone)
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'тречаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'met, was meeting', paired with 'встретиться'.

examples.text: Мы встречаемся уже месяц.
examples.trans: We've been dating for a month.

examples.text: Мы часто встречаемся.
examples.trans: We meet often.

examples.text: Мы уже месяц встречаемся.
examples.trans: We've been going out for a month already.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'yes', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: И она сразу сказала мне да!
examples.trans: And she immediately said yes to me!

examples.text: Луи, быстро неси сюда рюмки!
examples.trans: Louis, quickly bring the shot glasses here!

examples.text: Тогда нам тем более нужно выпить!
examples.trans: Then we have all the more reason to drink!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Пойдём со мной в кабинет, Максим.
examples.trans: Come with me to the office, Maxim.

examples.text: Давай лучше ещё немного выпьем.
examples.trans: Let's rather have a little more to drink.

examples.text: За мной огромный голодный лев бежал!
examples.trans: A huge hungry lion was running after me!

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'прос'). Common masculine noun meaning 'questions' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Ваша честь, у меня есть важный вопрос.
examples.trans: Your Honor, I have an important question.

examples.text: Да! У меня больше нет вопросов!
examples.trans: Yes! I have no further questions!

examples.text: У меня вопрос.
examples.trans: I have a question.
